'''Plessus Weege''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] on [[Draenell's Point]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on the planet, he took to informing on the local citizenry for the Empire. Weege hung around the ''[[Farmer's Folly]]'' waiting to hear "Rebel talk", then inform upon the individual to the nearest Imperial checkpoint.
